stem: Which quotation from the article best supports the idea that the contents of the time capsule held public interest?

options.label: A
options.text: When workers found the time capsule containing the plaque and other items, they realized that the contents were of historic importance. (paragraph 5)

options.label: B
options.text: The preservationists made a list of what was found in the time capsule. (paragraph 6)

options.label: C
options.text: The time capsule items were kept on display for a short while at the Museum of Fine Arts in Boston. (paragraph 9)

options.label: D
options.text: How long will the time capsule remain behind the cornerstone? (paragraph 10)
